_sobre: Uma pose por miniatura, escrita à mão: a técnica do clã e o jeito do personagem na arte dele (o bestiário), sem repetir pose dentro do clã. `quem` substitui a descrição tirada do pedido da arte quando ele não segue o padrão (Nível Anbu, alguns Jounin e Líderes).

cla-aburame--genin.pose: standing quietly with one hand in his coat pocket, the other hand raised at chest height with a single beetle resting on his outstretched index finger, looking at it calmly

cla-aburame--chunin.pose: standing straight like a scholar, holding an open glass insect jar in one hand and its lid in the other, a thin stream of tiny black insects rising out of the jar

cla-aburame--jounin.pose: a wide confident grin, both arms stretched out to the sides with open palms, dark swarms of tiny insects pouring out of his sleeves

cla-aburame--nivel-anbu.quem: an original Aburame clan ANBU of Konoha, a tall man in a dark high-collared hooded coat over the Konoha ANBU gear (grey armored vest, long black arm guards), round dark sunglasses under the hood
cla-aburame--nivel-anbu.pose: standing still with his arms crossed over his chest, a thin cloud of tiny black beetles drifting out from under his hood

cla-aburame--lider-do-cla.pose: standing calmly with both hands clasped behind his back, a small column of insects spiraling around his feet, stern and patient

cla-akimichi--genin.pose: standing proudly with one hand on her hip and the other holding up a skewer of three dumplings, cheeks puffed while chewing

cla-akimichi--chunin.pose: yawning with one arm stretched up over his head, the other hand patting his big round belly, relaxed and drowsy

cla-akimichi--jounin.pose: a wide low sumo-like stance, one arm expanded into a giant oversized fist raised beside his head, the other fist at his hip, stern frown

cla-akimichi--nivel-anbu.quem: an original Akimichi clan ANBU of Konoha, a big heavyset man with long spiky brown hair and red swirl marks on his cheeks, a white ANBU mask with red butterfly-wing markings pushed up on his head, grey armored vest over a black sleeveless shirt, long black arm guards
cla-akimichi--nivel-anbu.pose: cracking his knuckles with both fists pressed together in front of his chest, heavy and steady stance

cla-akimichi--lider-do-cla.pose: standing tall and huge with both fists clenched at his sides, faint butterfly-shaped chakra wings glowing on his back, calm and powerful

cla-hozuki--genin.pose: standing lazily with one hand in her pocket, the other hand melting into water that drips to the ground, a sly fox-like smile

cla-hozuki--chunin.pose: grinning with sharp teeth, balancing on one foot in a playful pose, one hand making a water gun with two fingers pointed forward

cla-hozuki--jounin.pose: a huge executioner's sword resting on his shoulder in one hand, drinking from a water bottle with the other hand

cla-hozuki--nivel-anbu.quem: an original Hozuki clan hunter-nin of Kirigakure, a young man with pale blue-white hair and sharp pointed teeth, a smooth white hunter-nin mask with the Mist village symbol, dark high-collared clothes
cla-hozuki--nivel-anbu.pose: crouched low and ready to spring, a short blade in a reverse grip, his legs half turned into liquid water

cla-hozuki--lider-do-cla.quem: the head of the Hozuki clan, a strong man in his late thirties with short pale silvery blue hair and sharp teeth, a dark grey-green high-collared robe and a big water gourd at his hip
cla-hozuki--lider-do-cla.pose: both hands resting on the pommel of a broad greatsword planted point-down in front of him, a sharp-toothed grin

cla-hyuuga--genin.pose: standing stiffly at attention, hands balled into fists at his sides, chin up, trying hard to look proud

cla-hyuuga--chunin.pose: Byakugan veins bulging around her eyes, two fingers raised in front of her face in a concentration seal, scanning into the distance

cla-hyuuga--jounin.pose: the Gentle Fist stance: legs wide and low, one open palm thrust forward and the other drawn back, fingertips glowing with blue chakra

cla-hyuuga--nivel-anbu.quem: an original Hyuuga clan ANBU of Konoha, a young man with long straight dark brown hair and pale pupilless eyes, a white owl ANBU mask on the side of his head, grey armored vest over a black sleeveless shirt, long black arm guards
cla-hyuuga--nivel-anbu.pose: one open palm raised in front of him, the other hand holding a tanto low behind his back, Byakugan veins around his eyes

cla-hyuuga--lider-do-cla.pose: an old clan head in a formal robe standing with his hands tucked inside his wide sleeves, chin raised, cold and judging stare

cla-inuzuka--genin.pose: a small white puppy poking its head out of the front of her jacket, both fists raised in a scrappy fighting stance, wide grin with fangs

cla-inuzuka--chunin.pose: laughing, a wet towel over one shoulder, pointing at himself with his thumb, relaxed and cheerful

cla-inuzuka--jounin.pose: crouched low on all fours like a beast, clawed fingers dug into the ground, glowing slit pupils, ready to pounce

cla-inuzuka--nivel-anbu.quem: an original Inuzuka clan ANBU of Konoha, a wiry young woman with short wild brown hair and red fang marks on her cheeks, a white wolf ANBU mask hanging at her neck, grey armored vest over a black sleeveless shirt, long black arm guards
cla-inuzuka--nivel-anbu.pose: a tanto drawn in one hand, the other hand's fingers curled like claws, head tilted up sniffing the air

cla-inuzuka--lider-do-cla.pose: holding up a big bone treat in one hand and whistling with two fingers of the other hand in his mouth, calling his dogs

cla-kaguya--genin.pose: head tilted with an unsettling smile, a sharp bone spike growing out of one raised fingertip

cla-kaguya--chunin.pose: a graceful dancer's pose on the toes of one foot, arms spread wide, curved bone blades growing from both elbows, eyes closed

cla-kaguya--jounin.quem: a young adult jounin of the Kaguya clan with long white hair and two red dots on the forehead, torn battle-worn clothes
cla-kaguya--jounin.pose: crouched like a wild animal on one knee, bone blades growing from both forearms, fierce hungry eyes

cla-kaguya--nivel-anbu.quem: an original Kaguya clan hunter-nin of Kirigakure, a pale man with long white hair, a smooth white hunter-nin mask with the Mist village symbol, dark high-collared clothes
cla-kaguya--nivel-anbu.pose: slowly pulling a long white bone sword out of the palm of one hand, sharp bone spikes jutting from his shoulders

cla-kaguya--lider-do-cla.quem: the elderly head of the Kaguya clan with long white hair, two red dots on the forehead and a beauty mark under one eye
cla-kaguya--lider-do-cla.pose: leaning on a tall walking staff made of bone, small bone spikes jutting from his shoulders, cold patient stare

cla-nara--genin.quem: a teenage kunoichi of the Nara clan, an original girl: long dark hair in a loose high ponytail that falls past her shoulders, long eyelashes, a soft feminine face with tired dark circles under the eyes, a slim girl's figure, a fitted green jacket and dark shorts, a different person from any famous clan member
cla-nara--genin.pose: yawning with one hand covering her mouth, the other hand in her jacket pocket, weight on one leg, sleepy half-closed eyes

cla-nara--chunin.pose: down on one knee, studying a shogi piece held between two fingers, a calm knowing smirk

cla-nara--jounin.pose: forming the Rat hand seal in front of his chest, his shadow stretching long and thin across the ground in front of him

cla-nara--nivel-anbu.quem: an original Nara clan ANBU of Konoha, a lean man with black hair tied in a high spiky ponytail, a white deer ANBU mask with red markings, grey armored vest over a black sleeveless shirt, long black arm guards
cla-nara--nivel-anbu.pose: one hand in his pocket, the other loosely holding a short knuckle-guard trench knife, unimpressed

cla-nara--lider-do-cla.pose: rolling up a bandage in his hands, a medicine pouch at his hip, a calm and wise half-smile

cla-sabaku--genin.quem: a teenage kunoichi of the Sabaku clan of Sunagakure, an original girl: messy dark brown bowl-cut hair, heavy thick eyebrows, a soft feminine face, a slim girl figure, a beige desert outfit with a sash, a big sand gourd, a different person from any famous clan member
cla-sabaku--genin.pose: hugging her big sand gourd in front of her with both arms, peeking over it with a shy smile, a thin ribbon of sand drifting around her feet

cla-sabaku--chunin.pose: grinning while riding a small floating board of sand, arms out for balance, knees bent

cla-sabaku--jounin.pose: reading a mission scroll held open in both hands, sand drifting upward around her feet, unbothered

cla-sabaku--nivel-anbu.quem: an original Sabaku clan ANBU of Sunagakure, a small figure in a beige hooded cloak and a white mask with red markings, a big sand gourd on his back
cla-sabaku--nivel-anbu.pose: one arm raised with the palm open while a stream of sand coils around the arm like a snake

cla-sabaku--lider-do-cla.pose: standing firm with both arms raised and palms forward, holding back a wall of sand, jaw clenched

cla-senju--genin.pose: kneeling on one knee with both hands held out in front of her, glowing with green healing chakra

cla-senju--chunin.pose: leaning back casually with arms crossed, a small leafy sapling sprouting from her shoulder, sleepy smile

cla-senju--jounin.pose: palms pressed together in a hand seal, young wooden branches growing out of the ground around his feet

cla-senju--nivel-anbu.quem: an original Senju clan ANBU of Konoha, a woman with long dark brown hair in a low ponytail, a white tortoise ANBU mask with red markings, grey armored vest over a black sleeveless shirt, long black arm guards
cla-senju--nivel-anbu.pose: a ninjato drawn and held in a two-handed guard in front of her

cla-senju--lider-do-cla.pose: standing tall with eyes closed and hands folded inside his sleeves, small roots curling around his sandals, serene

cla-uchiha--chunin.pose: head slightly bowed and eyes half closed, both hands pressed together in front of his chest in a quiet hand seal, a string of prayer beads wrapped around one wrist, a kunai holstered on his thigh

cla-uchiha--genin.pose: one eye glowing red, three kunai fanned between the fingers of one raised hand ready to throw, the other hand stretched forward to aim

cla-uchiha--jounin.quem: a young adult jounin of the Uchiha clan with messy dark hair, a high collared navy shirt with the red and white Uchiha fan crest and red Sharingan eyes with three tomoe
cla-uchiha--jounin.pose: one hand in his pocket, the other raised in front of his face with two fingers up in a one-handed seal, a piercing Sharingan stare

cla-uchiha--nivel-anbu.quem: Izo Uchiha, a young Konoha ANBU of the Uchiha clan, an original character from the user's campaign: messy black hair with long bangs over one eye, pale skin, a red Sharingan eye with three tomoe, a white porcelain crow ANBU mask with a short beak and red markings, grey armored vest over a black sleeveless high-necked shirt, the red ANBU spiral tattoo on the upper arm, long black arm guards, the hilt of a tanto over his shoulder
cla-uchiha--nivel-anbu.pose: lifting his white crow mask away from his face with one gloved hand, the other hand resting on the hilt of the tanto over his shoulder, cold and calm

cla-uchiha--lider-do-cla.quem: the elderly head of the Uchiha clan with a short low ponytail and a scar on the chin, a dark formal robe with the red and white Uchiha fan crest
cla-uchiha--lider-do-cla.pose: arms crossed, chin raised, glaring with red Sharingan eyes, proud and imposing

cla-uzumaki--genin.pose: holding a big calligraphy brush in one hand and a paper sealing tag between two fingers of the other, ink stains on her face, eager

cla-uzumaki--chunin.pose: an open sealing scroll unrolled from one hand down to the ground, the other hand pressed flat on the scroll

cla-uzumaki--jounin.quem: a jounin of the Uzumaki clan with bright red hair in a long braid and a short goatee, battle-worn clothes with small cuts
cla-uzumaki--jounin.pose: hands locked together in a sealing hand sign in front of his chest, golden chakra chains coiling out from his back

cla-uzumaki--nivel-anbu.quem: an original Uzumaki clan ANBU of Konoha, a young woman with short messy bright red hair, a white ANBU mask with red whirlpool markings, grey armored vest over a black sleeveless shirt, long black arm guards
cla-uzumaki--nivel-anbu.pose: down on one knee slamming one palm on the ground, a small glowing sealing formula spreading in a circle around her hand

cla-uzumaki--lider-do-cla.pose: a closed sealing scroll held under one arm, the other hand raised in a one-handed seal, long red hair, wise and fierce

cla-yamanaka--genin.quem: a teenage boy of the Yamanaka clan, an original boy with a boyish face and a crooked broken nose, platinum blond hair tied in a low ponytail, broad shoulders, the clan purple and grey outfit, a different person from any famous clan member
cla-yamanaka--genin.pose: holding a small flower bouquet behind his back with one hand and scratching his head sheepishly with the other

cla-yamanaka--chunin.pose: forming the Mind Transfer hand sign: thumbs and index fingers joined in a diamond shape aimed forward, focused eyes

cla-yamanaka--jounin.pose: two fingers pressed to her temple with eyes closed and a faint glow around her head, the other hand open toward the front, sensing

cla-yamanaka--nivel-anbu.quem: an original Yamanaka clan ANBU of Konoha, a woman with pale blond hair in a long braid over her shoulder, a white boar ANBU mask tied at the side of her head, grey armored vest over a black sleeveless shirt, long black arm guards
cla-yamanaka--nivel-anbu.pose: crouched and stealthy, a tanto held in a reverse grip close to her chest

cla-yamanaka--lider-do-cla.quem: the head of the Yamanaka clan, a man in his forties with platinum blond hair in a short low ponytail, the long dark coat of Konoha's Intelligence Division
cla-yamanaka--lider-do-cla.pose: one hand raised with fingers spread and a faint blue glow of mind chakra in the palm, the other hand behind his back, intimidating stare

cla-yuki--genin.pose: holding a single delicate ice flower in her cupped hands, a gentle smile

cla-yuki--chunin.pose: gliding on one foot as if skating, arms spread, ice crystals trailing from his fingertips

cla-yuki--jounin.pose: forming a one-handed seal in front of her face, the other arm stretched to the side while sharp ice crystals grow along it, tired but cold eyes

cla-yuki--nivel-anbu.quem: an original Yuki clan hunter-nin, a woman with short black hair and pale skin, a thick grey fur-lined coat, a smooth white hunter-nin mask with the Mist village symbol
cla-yuki--nivel-anbu.pose: three thin ice needles held between the fingers of one raised hand, the other hand tucked in her fur-lined coat, frost breath

cla-yuki--lider-do-cla.pose: holding up a paper lantern in one hand, frost spreading from the fingertips of the other hand, walking forward slowly
